تنتشلوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِلُوا (tantašilū) /tan.ta.ʃi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# تُنْتَشَلُوا (tuntašalū) /tun.ta.ʃa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
